# The Valuation Node
> Independent research and learning on Indian markets, authored by Gajji Srinath.

The Valuation Node publishes original equity valuation and credit analysis of Indian companies,
alongside a structured free learning library covering accounting, corporate finance, valuation,
credit analysis, ESG, fintech, and markets. All content cites sources and shows its methodology.
No investment advice is given. No paid promotions.

## Insights & Analysis
Original analysis of Indian companies, sectors, and valuation questions, in seven sub-sections:
company analysis, industry analysis, market analysis, financial analysis, economic analysis,
ESG analysis, and business case studies. Sub-sections without published work yet are marked
"coming soon".
URL: https://valuationnode.com/analysis

## News & Trends
Business news, markets news (Nifty 50 fundamentals), economy and policy (SEBI, NSE, BSE
compliance calendar), corporate news, ESG and sustainability news, technology and AI.
URL: https://valuationnode.com/news

## ESG & Sustainability
Green finance, corporate governance, impact investing, ESG ratings and frameworks.
URL: https://valuationnode.com/esg

## The Vault (reference library)
Financial Glossary (178 terms), Key Formulas & Ratios (49), Concept Guides (51 guides in
nine tracks: accounting, corporate finance, valuation, financial statement analysis, credit
analysis, markets and instruments, ESG, fintech, data and tools), and Model Templates &
Interactive (13 calculators, 5 lessons).
URL: https://valuationnode.com/vault

## Tools
13 free financial calculators for Indian investors: SIP, step-up SIP, goal SIP, DCF sensitivity,
WACC, CAGR, future and present value, compound interest, rule of 72, EMI, loan prepayment,
and inflation-adjusted returns.
URL: https://valuationnode.com/vault/interactive

## Ratio Analysis
Reference of 49 financial ratios for Indian markets, each with a definition, its formula,
benchmarks, a worked example, and where the ratio misleads. Covers valuation multiples,
profitability and returns, leverage and liquidity, efficiency, cash flow checks, banking
ratios (CASA, NIM, NPA, CAR, PCR, cost to income), growth, and shareholding pattern.
URL: https://valuationnode.com/vault/formulas

## Glossary
Searchable glossary of 178 Indian market and finance terms, each with a definition, formula
where applicable, why it matters, and an example.
URL: https://valuationnode.com/vault/glossary

## Learn-by-Doing
Five interactive modules: build a DCF step by step, read an income statement line by line,
compute ratios from raw statements, compare two companies, and spot financial red flags.
URL: https://valuationnode.com/vault/interactive

## Author
Gajji Srinath, Founder and Editor, MBA Candidate at NIT Rourkela.
Contact: srinath@valuationnode.com

URL: https://valuationnode.com/about/author

## Editorial Principles
1. All sources are cited.
2. Methodology is shown (models, assumptions, data sources).
3. Uncertainty is named, not hidden.
4. No investment advice.
5. No sponsored content.
